title: Azure Cloud Engineer
description: Build and manage enterprise cloud infrastructure using Microsoft Azure, Azure Resource Manager (ARM/Bicep), Entra ID, and Azure Kubernetes Service.

goal.objective: Engineer reliable, secure, and compliance-driven cloud solutions on the Microsoft Azure ecosystem for enterprise clients.
career_pillars: Azure Virtual Networks & Entra ID Security

learn.summary: Master Azure Virtual Networks, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure VMs, App Services, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor, and IaC with Bicep.
key_competencies: Azure Virtual Networks, NSGs & Azure Firewall
Microsoft Entra ID (RBAC, PIM, Conditional Access)
Infrastructure as Code with Bicep & Azure CLI

capstone_projects.title: Enterprise Secure Hub-and-Spoke VNet Topology on Azure
capstone_projects.description: Deploy a compliant enterprise hub-spoke network with centralized firewall inspection, private endpoints, and Bastion host access.

capstone_projects.title: Enterprise Azure Landing Zone & AKS Cluster Automation
capstone_projects.description: Design an enterprise-scale Azure Landing Zone deploying private AKS clusters, Application Gateway Ingress, Key Vault CSI secret drivers, and automated policy guardrails.

certifications: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
interview_focus: Entra ID Conditional Access & PIM (Privileged Identity Management)
Azure Storage Redundancy Options (LRS, ZRS, GRS)

tree.name: Azure Fundamentals & Core Concepts
tree.description: Establish an unshakeable Microsoft Azure foundation: cloud architectural paradigms, Azure global infrastructure, cloud economics, and modern management tooling.

children.name: Introduction to Cloud Computing
children.description: Understand enterprise cloud architectures: comparing IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, and serverless compute models; evaluating Capex vs Opex financial models; and assessing cloud scalability, elastic provisioning, and high availability SLAs.

children.name: Azure Architecture & Services Overview
children.description: Master the Azure global backbone: Geographies, paired Regions (data residency and cross-region recovery), Availability Zones (AZs), fault domains and update domains within datacenters, and edge locations.

children.name: Azure Management Tools & Interfaces
children.description: Master enterprise Azure administration: Azure Portal, Azure CLI (`az` commands with JMESPath query filtering), Azure PowerShell (`Az` module), and Azure Resource Manager (ARM) declarative control plane.

children.name: Azure Pricing, SLAs, and Support
children.description: Master Azure cost estimation and financial governance: Azure Pricing Calculator, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) calculator, understanding composite Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and selecting enterprise support tiers.

resources.title: Predict and optimize costs with Azure Cost Management and Billing

tree.name: Azure Identity & Access Management
tree.description: Master enterprise zero-trust identity and access control: Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), role-based access control, privileged identity lifecycles, and secure credential storage.

children.name: Azure Active Directory Fundamentals
children.description: Deep dive into Microsoft Entra ID: users, security groups, administrative units, tenant boundaries, application registrations, and service principals for workload identities.

resources.title: Manage users and groups in Azure Active Directory

children.name: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
children.description: Implement granular Role-Based Access Control (Azure RBAC): built-in roles (Owner, Contributor, Reader) vs custom roles, inheritance across Management Group, Subscription, Resource Group, and Resource scopes, and enforcing phishing-resistant Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).

resources.title: What is Azure role-based access control (Azure RBAC)?

children.name: Hybrid Identity with Azure AD Connect
children.description: Architect hybrid identity federation: Microsoft Entra Connect sync (password hash synchronization, pass-through authentication, and Active Directory Federation Services ADFS), and seamless single sign-on (SSO).

resources.title: Choose the right authentication method for your Azure AD hybrid identity solution

children.name: Azure AD Conditional Access
children.description: Design zero-trust Conditional Access policies: evaluating user risk, sign-in risk, device compliance (Intune), IP locations, and client apps to enforce MFA, block access, or require compliant devices.

children.name: Managed Identities for Azure Resources
children.description: Eliminate hard-coded credentials using Azure Managed Identities: System-Assigned vs User-Assigned Managed Identities, authenticating Azure compute workloads (VMs, App Services, Functions, AKS) directly against Azure Key Vault, Azure SQL, and Storage.

resources.title: What are managed identities for Azure resources?
Configure managed identities for Azure resources

children.name: Azure Key Vault for Secrets Management
children.description: Secure cryptographic assets with Azure Key Vault: managing HSM-backed encryption keys, database connection strings, and TLS certificates, configuring RBAC-based access models, automated certificate renewal, and soft-delete/purge protection.

resources.title: Integrate Key Vault with Azure services

children.name: Azure AD Identity Protection & Governance
children.description: Implement Privileged Identity Management (PIM): just-in-time (JIT) role activation with approval workflows, time-bound access, access reviews, identity risk detection, and automated governance.

resources.title: What is Azure AD Privileged Identity Management?

tree.name: Azure Networking Services
tree.description: Architect secure, isolated enterprise virtual networks: hybrid connectivity, micro-segmentation, traffic routing, and perimeter security.

children.name: Virtual Networks (VNets) & Subnets
children.description: Design Azure Virtual Networks (VNets): CIDR IP address planning, subnet segmentation (web, app, data, gateway, and bastion subnets), and public vs private IP allocation.

resources.title: Design an IP addressing plan for your Azure deployment

children.name: Azure Network Security (NSG, ASG, Azure Firewall)
children.description: Implement network traffic inspection: stateful Network Security Groups (NSGs), Application Security Groups (ASGs) for micro-segmentation, and Azure Firewall Premium (IDPS, TLS inspection, URL filtering, FQDN tagging).

resources.title: Azure Networking Tutorial | Virtual Networks, NSG, DNS, Load Balancer, VPN

children.name: Load Balancing & Traffic Management (LB, AGW, AFD, TM)
children.description: Configure Layer 4 and Layer 7 traffic distribution: Azure Load Balancer (Standard SKU, ultra-low latency, backend pools, health probes), Azure Application Gateway with WAF v2 (URL-based routing, SSL offloading, cookie-based affinity), and Azure Front Door for global Anycast routing.

children.name: Hybrid Network Connectivity (VPN Gateway & ExpressRoute)
children.description: Establish secure hybrid enterprise connectivity: Site-to-Site (S2S) VPN, Point-to-Site (P2S) VPN, and dedicated Azure ExpressRoute private high-throughput peering with redundant circuit failover.

children.name: Azure DNS & Content Delivery Network (CDN)
children.description: Manage global domain names and static asset acceleration: Azure DNS public and private hosted zones (automatic registration), and Azure Content Delivery Network (CDN) with origin shielding and custom domain SSL.

children.name: VNet Peering & Custom Routing (UDRs)
children.description: Design Hub-and-Spoke network topologies: VNet Peering (regional and global), custom User Defined Routes (UDRs) forcing traffic through central firewalls, and Azure Virtual Network Gateway route propagation.

resources.title: Route virtual network traffic with a user-defined route
Azure Custom Routing (UDR) in Azure Virtual Network | Learn Networking in Azure

children.name: Azure Private Link & Service Endpoints
children.description: Eliminate exposure to the public internet: Service Endpoints for subnet-level access, and Azure Private Link / Private Endpoints securing PaaS services (Azure SQL, Storage, Key Vault) with private IP addresses in your VNet.

resources.title: Azure Private Link vs Service Endpoints Explained in Detail
Azure Private Link and Private Endpoint Explained

children.name: Azure DDoS Protection
children.description: Mitigate volumetric network attacks: Azure DDoS Protection Network IP Protection, adaptive attack tuning, real-time telemetry, and rapid response support integration.

tree.name: Azure Compute Services
tree.description: Deploy, scale, and orchestrate enterprise compute workloads: virtual machines, PaaS application runtimes, serverless microservices, and Kubernetes clusters.

children.name: Azure Virtual Machines (VMs) & VM Scale Sets
children.description: Engineer scalable infrastructure with Azure VMs and VMSS: sizing instance series (B, D, E, F series), availability sets, Virtual Machine Scale Sets with autoscale rules (CPU, memory, custom metrics), and Azure Bastion for secure, port-less management.

resources.title: What are Azure virtual machine scale sets?
Availability options for Azure Virtual Machines

children.name: Azure App Service (Web Apps, API Apps)
children.description: Deploy enterprise web applications with Azure App Service: deployment slots with zero-downtime swaps, App Service Plans, regional VNet integration for private outbound access, custom domains, and auto-scaling.

resources.title: Create a web app in Azure App Service

children.name: Azure Functions & Logic Apps (Serverless Compute)
children.description: Build event-driven microservices with Azure Functions: consumption vs premium plans, isolated worker process model (.NET 8/Python/Node.js), event triggers (Blob, Service Bus, Cosmos DB, Event Grid), and durable functions for stateful orchestration.

children.name: Azure Containers Fundamentals (ACI & Container Apps)
children.description: Run containerized applications: Azure Container Registry (ACR) with geo-replication, vulnerability scanning, and Azure Container Apps (ACA) built on KEDA (Kubernetes Event-driven Autoscaling) and Envoy proxy.

resources.title: Azure Container Apps - Simply Explained (Microservices, KEDA, Dapr)

children.name: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Fundamentals
children.description: Master Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS): managed control plane, Azure CNI vs Kubenet networking, Azure Entra ID integration with Kubernetes RBAC, system and user node pools, cluster autoscaler, and deploying with Helm.

resources.title: Build and run containerized applications with Azure Kubernetes Service

tree.name: Azure Storage & Data Services
tree.description: Engineer resilient, high-throughput cloud storage and database tiers: object, file, relational, and NoSQL storage engines.

resources.title: Explore relational data offerings in Azure

children.name: Azure Storage Accounts (Blob, File, Table, Queue)
children.description: Master Azure Storage Accounts: Blob storage tiers (Hot, Cool, Cold, Archive), lifecycle management policies, immutability (WORM compliance), redundancy models (LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS), and Shared Access Signatures (SAS) with stored access policies.

children.name: Azure Managed Disks & Snapshots
children.description: Configure Azure Managed Disks: Ultra Disks, Premium SSD v2, Standard SSD, disk encryption sets with customer-managed keys (CMK), and incremental disk snapshots.

children.name: Azure Relational Databases (SQL DB, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
children.description: Deploy scalable relational databases: Azure SQL Database (vCore model, Hyperscale, Elastic Pools, Active Geo-Replication, Auto-Failover Groups), and Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server with high availability.

resources.title: What is Azure Database for PostgreSQL?
What is Azure Database for MySQL?

children.name: Azure NoSQL Databases & Caching (Cosmos DB, Redis Cache)
children.description: Architect globally distributed NoSQL databases with Azure Cosmos DB: multi-region writes, partition key selection, 5 consistency levels (Strong, Bounded Staleness, Session, Consistent Prefix, Eventual), and NoSQL/MongoDB APIs.

resources.title: What is Azure Cache for Redis?

children.name: Azure File Sync & Azure NetApp Files
children.description: Deploy enterprise file sharing: Azure Files SMB/NFS shares, Azure File Sync for on-premises server tiering, and Azure NetApp Files for ultra-high performance enterprise storage.

resources.title: What is Azure NetApp Files How it works How to deploy it

children.name: Azure Data Migration Services
children.description: Execute database and data migrations: Azure Database Migration Service (DMS), Azure Data Factory ETL pipelines, and Azure Storage Data Movement libraries.

resources.title: What is Azure Database Migration Service?

tree.name: Azure Monitoring & Cost Management
tree.description: Implement enterprise observability and FinOps governance: distributed metrics, logs, diagnostic settings, and proactive cost controls.

resources.title: Predict and optimize costs with Azure Cost Management and Billing

children.name: Azure Monitor, Log Analytics & Application Insights
children.description: Master observability with Azure Monitor: Log Analytics workspaces, writing analytical queries using Kusto Query Language (KQL), and Application Insights distributed tracing, exception tracking, and live metrics stream.

children.name: Azure Alerts, Action Groups & Dashboards
children.description: Configure proactive alerting: metric alerts, log search alerts with KQL, Action Groups (email, SMS, webhooks, Azure Functions), and automated remediation runbooks.

resources.title: Create, view, and manage metric alerts in Azure Monitor
Create and manage action groups in the Azure portal

children.name: Azure Resource Health & Service Health
children.description: Track infrastructure health: Azure Service Health (service issues, planned maintenance, health advisories), Resource Health, and configuring automated notification alerts.

children.name: Azure Cost Management & Billing
children.description: Execute FinOps cost governance: Azure Cost Management + Billing, budget thresholds with automated email alerts, cost allocation tags, Azure Advisor cost recommendations, and Azure Reservations and Savings Plans.

resources.title: Optimize your cloud investment with Azure Cost Management

tree.name: Azure Governance & Compliance
tree.description: Enforce enterprise governance and compliance: hierarchical resource organization, policy guardrails, and compliance tracking.

children.name: Azure Management Groups & Subscriptions
children.description: Design enterprise resource hierarchies: Root Management Group, child Management Groups, Subscriptions (production, staging, sandbox), and Resource Groups for lifecycle isolation.

resources.title: Organize your resources with Azure management groups

children.name: Azure Policy & Azure Blueprints
children.description: Enforce organizational guardrails with Azure Policy: custom JSON policy definitions, initiatives (policy sets), effects (Deny, Audit, AuditIfNotExists, Modify), and remediating non-compliant resources.

children.name: Azure Resource Tags & Locks
children.description: Implement resource governance: standardized tag schemas (Environment, CostCenter, Owner) and Resource Locks (CanNotDelete, ReadOnly) to prevent accidental deletion of critical infrastructure.

resources.title: Use tags to organize your Azure resources and management hierarchy
Lock resources to prevent unexpected changes

children.name: Azure Compliance & Auditing
children.description: Audit regulatory compliance: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Regulatory Compliance dashboard (CIS Azure Foundations, NIST, ISO 27001), and Azure Activity Log auditing.

resources.title: Introduction to Azure security, privacy, and compliance

tree.name: Azure Automation & Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
tree.description: Automate cloud infrastructure and configuration: declarative templates, Infrastructure as Code, and automated state configuration.

resources.title: Automate Azure tasks by using runbooks and Azure Automation
Automate your deployments with Azure Resource Manager templates

children.name: Azure Automation (Runbooks, State Configuration)
children.description: Automate cloud operations with Azure Automation: PowerShell and Python runbooks, hybrid runbook workers, and scheduled execution.

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with ARM/Bicep/Terraform
children.description: Master Infrastructure as Code on Azure: Bicep domain-specific language (modules, parameters, outputs, target scopes) and HashiCorp Terraform (AzureRM provider, remote backend with Azure Blob Storage and state lease locking, and CI/CD validation).

resources.title: Use Terraform to create Azure infrastructure

children.name: Configuration Management & Desired State Configuration (DSC)
children.description: Automate server state configuration: Azure Automanage Machine Configuration (formerly Azure Automation State Configuration / PowerShell DSC) for consistent OS baseline configuration.

tree.name: Azure DevOps & CI/CD
tree.description: Implement enterprise continuous integration and deployment: Azure Repos, multi-stage pipelines, and artifact management.

resources.title: Create a CI/CD pipeline with Azure DevOps

children.name: Introduction to Azure DevOps Services
children.description: Master the Azure DevOps suite: Azure Boards (agile sprint planning), Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines, Azure Test Plans, and Azure Artifacts.

children.name: Git & Version Control for Azure Projects
children.description: Implement enterprise Git workflows in Azure Repos: branch protection policies, PR code reviews, build validation triggers, and commit signing.

resources.title: Share your code with Git in Azure Repos

children.name: Building & Managing CI/CD Pipelines (Azure Pipelines)
children.description: Build multi-stage YAML pipelines in Azure Pipelines: build stages, test automation, self-hosted vs Microsoft-hosted build agents, variable groups with Azure Key Vault integration, and container image generation.

children.name: Release Management & Deployment Strategies
children.description: Deploy zero-downtime releases: deployment environments with manual approval checks, deployment gates (querying Azure Monitor alerts), blue/green deployments, and canary rollouts.

children.name: Artifact Management & Container Registries
children.description: Manage package feeds: publishing and consuming private NuGet, npm, Maven, and Python packages via Azure Artifacts with upstream sources.

resources.title: Introduction to private Docker container registries in Azure

tree.name: Advanced Operations & Solution Design
tree.description: Architect resilient, mission-critical systems: disaster recovery, multi-region failover, cloud migration, and advanced threat protection.

children.name: High Availability & Disaster Recovery Strategies
children.description: Architect enterprise disaster recovery: multi-region active-active vs active-passive failover, calculating RTO and RPO, and global traffic routing with Azure Front Door.

children.name: Azure Backup & Recovery Services
children.description: Manage enterprise backup: Azure Backup Vault and Recovery Services Vault, backing up Azure VMs, Azure SQL, and Azure Files, with Cross-Region Restore (CRR) capabilities.

resources.title: Implement Azure Backup Service | Step By Step Tutorial
Azure Backup Service Tutorial For Beginners | Azure Backup And Recovery Manager Tutorial

children.name: Hybrid & Multi-cloud Management (Azure Arc, Stack HCI)
children.description: Manage hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure: Azure Arc for servers, Kubernetes, and data services outside Azure, providing unified governance and monitoring.

children.name: Advanced Data Platform Operations
children.description: Architect modern data platforms: Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (hierarchical namespace).

resources.title: Introduction to Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2
Azure Synapse Analytics Full Course for Beginners - Learn Analytics with Azure Synapse

children.name: Cloud Migration Strategies & Tools
children.description: Execute enterprise cloud migrations: Azure Migrate discovery, assessment, dependency mapping, and agentless replication for VMware and Hyper-V workloads.

children.name: Azure Messaging & Event Services
children.description: Build enterprise event-driven architectures: Azure Service Bus (queues, topics, subscriptions, sessions, dead-letter queues), Azure Event Grid (reactive pub/sub routing), and Azure Event Hubs (high-throughput big data streaming).

children.name: Advanced Network Security & Threat Protection
children.description: Harden network perimeters: Azure Virtual WAN, zero-trust network architectures, securing hybrid connections with ExpressRoute MACsec, and centralized egress filtering.

resources.title: What is Azure Web Application Firewall?

children.name: Azure Defender for Cloud & Microsoft Sentinel
children.description: Deploy cloud-native security operations: Microsoft Defender for Cloud (Cloud Security Posture Management CSPM and Cloud Workload Protection CWPP), and Microsoft Sentinel SIEM/SOAR (KQL analytics rules, incident response playbooks).

resources.title: What is Microsoft Defender for Cloud?
Microsoft Defender For Cloud (Azure Security Center) Tutorial for Beginners

children.name: Azure Well-Architected Framework & Best Practices
children.description: Apply the Azure Well-Architected Framework: Reliability, Security, Cost Optimization, Operational Excellence, and Performance Efficiency.

tree.name: Project & Career Readiness
tree.description: Build an enterprise portfolio, author operational runbooks, prepare for AZ-104 and AZ-305 certifications, and excel in Azure engineering interviews.

resources.title: AZ-104: Microsoft Azure Administrator Certification Prep Guide

children.name: Azure Cloud Engineer Capstone Project
children.description: Capstone Project: Architect and deploy an Enterprise Azure Landing Zone: Hub-and-Spoke network with Azure Firewall, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure SQL Failover Group, Azure Key Vault, Azure Front Door, provisioned via Terraform/Bicep with Azure DevOps CI/CD.

children.name: Technical Documentation & Runbook Creation
children.description: Author professional engineering runbooks: documenting failover procedures, disaster recovery drills, incident triage checklists, and architecture decision records (ADRs).

resources.title: Technical Writing 101 - A FREE Full Course on How to Write Technical Documentation

children.name: Advanced Troubleshooting & Performance Tuning
children.description: Troubleshoot complex Azure infrastructure issues: analyzing Network Watcher packet captures, debugging VM boot diagnostics, and optimizing database performance with Azure SQL Query Performance Insight.

resources.title: Azure Monitor & Log Analytics Deep Dive (Kusto Query Language)
Azure Cost Management and Optimization Walkthrough

children.description: Prepare for Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator (AZ-104) and Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305) exams, and master cloud system design interviews.
